body.name: population cumulant-flag class
body.construction: Let \(\Theta_{\mathrm{pop}}\) be the class of structural parameters \(\theta=(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\{\epsilon_{u,e},\epsilon_{t,e}\}_{e\in\mathcal E},\epsilon_y)\) satisfying \(U_e=\epsilon_{u,e}\), \(T_e=\alpha U_e+\epsilon_{t,e}\), and \(Y_e=\beta T_e+\gamma U_e+\epsilon_y\) in every environment, such that the three source variables are mutually independent within each environment, every source has a finite absolute moment of every positive integer order, \(\operatorname{rank}(C)=d\), and \(u_k\in A=\operatorname{col}(C)\) for every integer \(k\geq2\).  No coefficient bound, fixed singular-value gap, finite order cap, or source-swap closure is imposed in \(\Theta_{\mathrm{pop}}\).
